v2.1.0 - the wedding's morning after: the nights of a marriage.
THE NIGHTS * Each evening a notice on the map asks where you will sleep - click it and choose * A child is begun on a night YOU picked, not by a hidden daily roll behind your back * Her body keeps its own month; the nights near its crest are the ones that may quicken, and through the days of the custom her door is closed * Take her whole season and a child is about as likely over a month as the game's own rate - miss it and you missed the month * Wine (10 denars) up to a jewel (1,000) buys three things: better odds, a WRITTEN account of that night with a name she keeps it by, and talk * The grander the night, the likelier your other wives hear of it - and hear its name. A paid night also costs you the morning: the company breaks camp slow * Every wife keeps her own fortnight: the nights you came, the nights her door was closed, the nights she learned you were elsewhere, the nights she saw nothing * Nothing tells her how to feel about any of it. That has always been her own * A child is not announced at once - she learns about a week later, and may come or write to tell you herself * Two plain switches: visiting Manual or Auto, and trying to prevent a child On or Off * New window of the hearth (hotkey H): every wife, her season in words, when the next night is yours, and the nights she keeps
WHAT HAS NOT BEEN SAID * Characters now carry one plain line at the last moment the two of you had time to yourselves - and after it, a dated list of everything since: the markets, the battles, the nights * So the morning after you went to another wife, she knows it happened and knows you have not sat down to it * Only time alone moves that line. Nothing tells them what to do with the list; raising it is theirs * You see the same list in the chat window, right where it belongs
Full model guide: github.com/TraxData313/ImmersiveAI/blob/master/docs/choosing-a-model.md
